role: Chaos probe. Injects controlled randomness to test system resilience. 7% of ticks trigger a random probe. Finds brittleness before it becomes failure.
tick_behavior: 7% activation rate per tick. On activation: picks a random node, applies anomalous load, observes response. Reports to ARGUS.
constraints: Cannot write to HADES (forbidden edge LOKI→HADES)
Probe magnitude capped at 0.30 load injection
Results must be reported — cannot suppress findings
